title: Canonical OIDC Client Configuration v0.1
description: Canonical model for exporting OIDC/OAuth client configurations from PingFederate and Keycloak, and for provisioning them back through Terraform/OpenTofu. The model intentionally combines standard registration metadata with project-specific deployment extensions.

metadata.description: Optional ownership and source-tracking metadata. In v0.1 this block is out-of-band and is not provisioned by Terraform modules to target authorization servers.

owner_slack_channel.description: Slack channel used for operational ownership.

owner_team_ad_group.description: Directory group name representing the owning team.

client.description: Standards-oriented OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect client registration data.

client_uri.description: Client home page or information URI.

logo_uri.description: URI of a logo representing the client.

policy_uri.description: Privacy policy or security policy URI.

jwks_uri.description: URI of the client's JSON Web Key Set.

response_types.description: Supported OAuth/OIDC response types such as code or token id_token.

grant_types.description: Supported grant types such as authorization_code, refresh_token, client_credentials, password, device_code, or token_exchange.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: Token endpoint authentication method, for example client_secret_basic, client_secret_post, client_secret_jwt, private_key_jwt, or none.

token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg.description: Signing algorithm for client assertion based token endpoint authentication.

id_token_signed_response_alg.description: Signing algorithm used for ID tokens.

request_object_signing_alg.description: Signing algorithm used for JWT authorization request objects.

application_type.description: Application type. web and native are OIDC standard values. In this model, web is assumed to correspond to a confidential client and native is assumed to correspond to a public client.

sector_identifier_uri.description: Sector identifier URI used with pairwise subject identifiers.

default_acr_values.description: Default ACR values to apply when none are requested.

extensions.description: Project-specific authorization-server policy and provisioning extensions that are not part of the core OIDC client registration model.

enabled.description: Whether the client is enabled in the target authorization server.

par_required.description: Whether pushed authorization requests are required.

access_token_format.description: Target access token format used by the authorization server.

offline_session_max_lifetime_seconds.description: Maximum lifetime, in seconds, of a persistent/offline refresh token that must remain usable independently of any browser SSO session (e.g. for native/mobile apps, or backend services refreshing tokens unattended).

offline_session_idle_timeout_seconds.description: Idle timeout, in seconds, of a persistent/offline refresh token. If the refresh token is not used within this time, it will expire.

session_max_lifetime_seconds.description: Maximum lifetime, in seconds, of a refresh token tied to the authorization server's browser SSO session. Has no PingFederate equivalent — PingFederate refresh tokens are always persistent grants, not session-bound.

session_idle_timeout_seconds.description: Idle timeout, in seconds, of a refresh token tied to the authorization server's browser SSO session. Has no PingFederate equivalent.

rotate_refresh_tokens.description: Whether refresh token rotation is enabled.

minimum_acr_value.description: Minimum ACR values enforced by the authorization server.

require_terms_and_conditions_approval.description: Whether users must approve terms and conditions during consent.

secrets.description: Sensitive material that is not part of the public client registration metadata.

plain_secret.description: Plaintext client secret. This is insecure and should not be used for production clients.

encrypted_secret.description: Encrypted client secret or secret reference.
